tools.name: packet_summary
tools.description: Parses a PCAP file and returns a high-density forensic summary: total packet count, start/end timestamps, duration, total wire bytes, average packet size, protocol distribution (TCP/UDP/ICMP/other), application protocol tags, unique source/dest IPs, and top 10 talkers.

input.description: Base64-encoded PCAP file bytes (max 10MB). Supported across both local and remote deployments.

filePath.description: Absolute filesystem path to a PCAP file (up to 500MB). Allowed ONLY on local stdio connections; rejected in remote HTTP/SSE mode.

tools.name: packet_list
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of packet summary records from a PCAP capture. Enforces strict LLM context limits with default limit 20 and max 100.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

offset.description: Zero-based packet index offset for pagination (default: 0).

limit.description: Maximum number of packets to return (default: 20, max: 100).

tools.name: packet_extract_conversations
tools.description: Aggregates and tracks bidirectional 5-tuple conversations (src/dst IP, ports, protocol). Computes sent/received packet and byte counts, duration, and TCP flag lifecycles (SYN/ACK/FIN/RST). Ranked by total bytes transferred.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return (default: 50, max: 200).

tools.name: packet_extract_dns
tools.description: Extracts and parses DNS queries and responses (RFC 1035) with label pointer loop protection. Aggregates query counts, unique domain rankings, and transaction details (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, PTR).

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

limit.description: Maximum number of DNS transactions to return (default: 50, max: 200).

tools.name: packet_extract_http
tools.description: Reassembles TCP streams and extracts HTTP/1.x requests and responses. Parses method, URI, headers, status codes, chunked transfers, body previews (4KB cap), and cognitive guidance hints.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

limit.description: Maximum number of HTTP transactions to return (default: 20, max: 100).

tools.name: packet_extract_tls_sni
tools.description: Extracts Server Name Indication (SNI) hostnames and client metadata from TLS ClientHello handshakes. Ranks accessed domains by frequency without decrypting payload data.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

limit.description: Maximum number of TLS handshakes to return (default: 50, max: 200).

tools.name: packet_detect_beacons
tools.description: Detects periodic C2 beacon communications using statistical time-delta variance (Coefficient of Variation, jitter %, median interval). Filters benign infrastructure (NTP, cloud IMDS, public resolvers) with confidence ratings (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW).

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

minConnections.description: Minimum recurring connection attempts to evaluate (default: 8).

includeBenign.description: Whether to include tagged benign services in the output (default: true).

tools.name: packet_detect_dns_tunneling
tools.description: Identifies DNS data exfiltration and tunneling channels (e.g. dnscat2, iodine, Cobalt Strike DNS beacons). Analyzes Shannon character entropy, subdomain label lengths, character set encodings (hex/base32/base64), and CDN heuristics.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

minSubdomains.description: Minimum unique subdomains under a parent domain to trigger analysis (default: 15).

tools.name: packet_extract_credentials
tools.description: Hunts for cleartext and recoverable credentials in HTTP Basic / Digest headers, URL query parameters, form/JSON POST bodies, FTP USER/PASS commands, and SMTP authentication.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

tools.name: packet_entropy
tools.description: Calculates Shannon entropy (0.0 to 8.0 bits/byte) to evaluate payload randomness and distinguish between plaintext, structured data (JSON/HTML/code), and encrypted / compressed malware or C2 traffic.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a PCAP file on disk (local stdio only).

packetIndex.description: Optional zero-based packet index to calculate entropy for a single packet payload.
